It’s no secret that my time in medicine almost killed me. - And I think the biggest reason why (more than the hours and the exhaustion) was this idea that we’re supposed to accept all of it with a smile. With gratitude. As if the system is doing us a FAVOUR. The 14-hour shifts, 7 days in a row. The mental overwhelm from having urgent 7 tasks competing for your attention. The constant anxiety and fear of making the wrong mistake that could cost a life. The superiors who look straight through you. And then, when you say anything about it, you’re met with: “Oh but how LUCKY are you to be a doctor?” “You’re saving lives, why would you want to do anything else?” That’s the part that really f*cking broke me 😞 I ended up leaving medicine because I just couldn’t take it any longer. And even then, I felt so guilty because of this exact attitude. I thought I was weak, for choosing not to suffer for such a prestigious career. But now that I’ve built a career that I genuinely LOVE and ENJOY every single day… I’ve learnt that suffering SHOULDN’T be a rite of passage. It’s not what makes you a good doctor. It’s not what makes you “worthy” of the title. And it was NEVER supposed to be the price you pay for a career that you love. The more that we say this out loud, and support others who are brave enough to say it too, the louder that calling gets. So, are you with me? 🙏🏽 - P.S. How to order coffee in Greece like a pro ☕🇬🇷 Recorded at @Pandrossos_Hotel_Paros 😍*invited  Greece’s coffee culture is on another level, with some iconic coffees that locals drink every single day. Of course, Greece also has cappuccinos, lattes, americanos, flat whites and all the other coffees you’re used to. But if you’re coming to Greece, you have to try ordering coffee the local way. Here’s exactly how it works. Step one: choose your coffee. ☕ Frappé Made with instant Nescafé and water, mixed until it becomes thick and foamy. The original Greek iced coffee. ☕ Freddo Espresso A cold espresso shaken with ice until it’s frothy and refreshing. ☕ Freddo Cappuccino A freddo espresso topped with a thick layer of cold milk foam. ☕ Ελληνικός Καφές (Ellinikós Kafés) Traditional Greek coffee made in a small briki pot. It’s served with the coffee grounds still inside the cup and is traditionally used for coffee reading. Now comes the important part. How sweet do you want it? 🖤 Σκέτο (Skéto) = no sugar 🤎 Μέτριο (Métrio) = medium sweet 🍯 Γλυκό (Glykó) = sweet You can also choose which sweetener you’d like: 🍬 Ζάχαρη (Záchari) = regular sugar 🤎 Μαύρη Ζάχαρη (Mávri Záchari) = brown sugar 💊 Ζαχαρίνη (Zacharíni) = saccharin 🌱 Στέβια (Stévia) = stevia If you want milk, you can ask for: 🥛 Γάλα (Gála) = regular milk 🌾 Γάλα Βρώμης (Gála Vrómis) = oat milk 🌰 Γάλα Αμυγδάλου (Gála Amygdálou) = almond milk 🥥 Γάλα Καρύδας (Gála Karýdas) = coconut milk 🌱 Γάλα Σόγιας (Gála Sógias) = soy milk If you’re ordering a freddo cappuccino, they’ll often ask if you want: ✨ Κανέλα (Kanéla) = cinnamon 🍫 Κακάο (Kakáo) = cacao And if you’re ordering a frappé, many places will also let you add a scoop of ice cream 🍨 One thing many tourists don’t know: Freddo espresso and freddo cappuccino are usually made with TWO shots of espresso. If you’d rather have a lighter coffee, ask for: ☕ Μονή Δόση (Moní Dósi) = single shot ☕ Ελαφρύ (Elafrý) = light My personal order? ☕ Ένα Φρέντο Καπουτσίνο Μέτριο, με Μαύρη Ζάχαρη, Κανέλα και Μονή Δόση (Ena Frénto Kapoutsíno Métrio, me Mávri Záchari, Kanéla kai Moní Dósi) A freddo cappuccino, medium sweet, with brown sugar, cinnamon and a single shot. Some more examples: ☕ Ένα Φραπέ Γλυκό με Γάλα (Ena Frappé Glykó me Gála) A sweet frappé with milk. ☕ Έναν Φρέντο Εσπρέσο Σκέτο (Enan Frénto Esprésso Skéto) A freddo espresso without sugar. ☕ Έναν Ελληνικό Καφέ Μέτριο (Enan Ellinikó Kafé Métrio) A medium-sweet Greek coffee. ☕ Ένα Φρέντο Καπουτσίνο με Γάλα Βρώμης και Στέβια (Ena Frénto Kapoutsíno me Gála Vrómis kai Stévia) A freddo cappuccino with oat milk and stevia. Now tell me YOUR perfect coffee order in the comments ☕👇 Write it in English and I’ll translate it into Greek for you. And if you want more practical Greece travel tips, Greek phrases, hidden gems and local knowledge, download my Ultimate Tourist Guide to Greece. It’s packed with the kind of information most tourists only learn after visiting Greece several times. #greecetravel #greekcoffee #greecetips #greecetiktok

So, how much did you understand?😎 Full scripts: A1 어제 아침에 일어났어요. 아침을 먹었어요. 화장실에 갔어요. 옷을 입었어요. A2 그리고 카페에 가서 커피 마시고 6시까지 공부했어요. 조금 피곤했지만 열심히 했어요. 공부 다 하고 집에 갔어요. B1 집에 도착해서 옷을 갈아입는데 지갑이 없었어요. 저는 보통 지갑을 바지 주머니에 넣어요. 그런데 거기에 없었어요. B2 그래서 가방이랑 다른 옷들을 다 뒤져봤는데도 보이지 않았어요. 그때 갑자기 카페에 두고 왔을지도 모른다는 생각이 들어서 급하게 다시 나갔어요. C1 나와서 카페로 향하는 내내 다른 생각은 전혀 안 들고, 그냥 '제발 (노트북➔지갑)이 거기 그대로 있어라'하는 마음뿐이었어요. 급한 마음에 옷도 제대로 안 챙겨입고 카페로 달려갔는데 이미 영업이 끝났었어요. C2 그래서 어쩔 수 없이 다시 집에 돌아왔고, 그날 밤에는 혹시 분실한 건 아닐까 하는 걱정에 쉽게 잠들지 못했어요. 다행히도 다음 날 눈 뜨자마자 카페에 연락해보니 직원이 (노트북➔지갑)을 안전하게 보관하고 있었고, 그제서야 긴장이 탁 풀렸어요. 어제오늘 정말 다사다난했어요.  #korean #learningkorean #fyp #kdrama #koreandrama
